scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently --names server,client --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @gymlog/server" "npm run dev -w @gymlog/client"
scripts.owner-invite: npm run db && npm run owner-invite:dev -w @gymlog/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/client/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p e2e
